comment: Hand-kept facts for random_party.py that the map scripts and wild tables don't say. Stage names are tools/rebalance/story_stages.json's; a stage means 'reachable before that stage's bosses'. Maps in no stage (and not *_Frlg) are post-game.
starters_comment: Birch's bag on Route 101. The starter families come from nowhere else.
deny_maps_comment: Maps only an event ticket (Mystery Gift) opens.
deny_wild_labels_comment: Altering Cave's other tables only replace the first through Mystery Gift.
table_gates_comment: The earliest stage a wild table can be used in: Surf and Rock Smash need their badges (OW_FIELD_MOVES_WITHOUT_MON: the badge alone), and each rod comes from Dewford, Route 118 and Mossdeep.
map_overrides_comment: Scripted sources whose map's stage isn't when they can be had.
